correctness.rationale: For every hole-free extremal animal at \(n=11\), the published Euler and edge-count identities give \(e_1=2n+2-2h=24-2h\). The four-center incidence bound forces \(h\le3\). The three-center case is exhausted by the five-cycle link: only a two-edge path can have an incident-tile union of size \(11\), and its endpoints have two symmetry types. Both unions are connected, hole-free 11-tile animals with \(h=3\) and perimeter \(18\); the source theorem excludes holes from any minimum-perimeter animal in the \(\{4,5\}\) tessellation.
